title: Swift tax rule pack
description: The description that sits beside a rule's .cel expression. The expression reads `inputs` and `constants` by name and gives the amount for one pay period.

source.description: The law, notice or link the figures come from.

source_files.description: Paths (relative to sources/) of the saved copies of what `source` cites; each is listed with its SHA-256 in sources/MANIFEST.json.

verified.description: True only once someone has checked every figure against `source`.

inputs.description: Names the expression reads besides the constants.

constants.description: Tables and rates. A bracket table is [[upper, rate], ...] ascending, the last upper null.

origin.description: Where `expect` comes from: a figure or worked example printed by the authority; a third party's example; or worked out from the source's rates by whoever wrote the pack.

source_ref.description: Where in the source the expected value is, or how it differs from it.
